2. Read the police report. Were you right?

Date: 21.12.24
Location: 128 Fernwood Dr.
Report number: 1478-24
Incident: Homicide

At 8:30 AM on December 21, officers arrived at 128 Fernwood Dr., finding Clara and William Hutchinson at the scene of a double homicide. Mrs. Hutchinson denied knowing the victims, Daniel Porter and Ashton Pikes, though neighbors linked her to both men, saying she had been dating both. William claimed self-defense, stating the men were in the house when he came home after his night shift, leading to their deaths. Both men were found with stab wounds, and a knife was recovered nearby. The Hutchinsons were taken in for questioning.

Useful vocabulary

at the scene — at the place where an incident happened
claim self-defense — say that you acted to protect yourself
be taken in for questioning — be brought to a police station to answer questions
